info.description: Documentation revision orbit-http-v2-r2 for HTTP API 2.0. Select this artifact with a full producer commit; request version selection is unchanged.

billedAmountPerPeriod.description: Recurring subscription amount after Stripe-calculated discounts, before tax, in the subscription currency's minor units. Excludes prorations, one-time charges and customer balance. Null when no recurring preview is available, including trials, cancellation and pauses; clients fall back to AmountPerPeriod.

DayOfWeekInput.description: MVC accepts case-insensitive names, surrounding whitespace, comma-separated names and signed 32-bit integers as numbers or numeric strings. Binding does not bypass habit validation.

fieldOptions.description: Only present for a required unresolved parent choice. Options contain exactly the matching parent habits and No parent; resolved or root items omit this field.
